description: This Java class 'RetrieveConnectionStrategy' implements a strategy for handling 'RetrieveConnection' commands within a connectivity messaging persistence system. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides the 'doApply' method to generate a result based on the presence of a Connection entity, returning either a successful response or an error.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a strategy to process RetrieveConnection commands by generating appropriate results based on entity existence.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that registers the 'RetrieveConnection' class type for this strategy.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Core method that applies the strategy logic, returning either a successful connection retrieval result or an error if the entity is not accessible.
